notes.title: Speedrun and Race to Ending B!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings paranormal investigators![/h3]

So far, we haven't seen a video of anyone completing [b]Ending B[/b] so we've launched this event for players who are up for the challenge. You may read the mechanics below:



[b]Phantom Project Race[/b]

• Complete the game on [b]Ending B Normal or Hard[/b] while recording your FULL gameplay.
• Upload your playthrough on YouTube and title it [b]Phantom Project Race[/b].
• Use Phantom Project in the Game title under Category in the Video details so we can easily find your video.
• The [b]first 10 players[/b] will have their channel names listed on a file that will be posted on the bulletin board in the game in the next update.
• This event will end as soon as 10 players have been confirmed.
• We will confirm via comment on your video so please allow comments on your video.



[b]Phantom Project Speedrun[/b]

• Complete the game on [b]Ending B Hard[/b] while recording your FULL gameplay with NO cuts in the middle.
• Upload your playthrough on YouTube and title it [b]Phantom Project Speedrun[/b] followed by your record time as shown in the ending. Example: [b]Phantom Project Speedrun 00 : 11 : 54[/b]
• Use Phantom Project in the Game title under Category in the Video details so we can easily find your video.
• The [b]top 10 players[/b] will have their channel names listed on a file that will be posted on the bulletin board in the game in the next update.
• This event will end when the month of January 2022 is over using the GMT +00:00 timezone.
• We will confirm via comment on your video so please allow comments on your video.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/4b22a1dcd463a7f4d7d0af9df1a2418f1e151c72.png[/img]
We've relaunched our Indiegogo campaign so you can support Phantom Project at [url=www.astravelari.com]www.astravelari.com[/url]! Please follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Astravelari-101485318973297]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/AstravelariLLC]Twitter[/url] for more exciting news and join us on [url=https://discord.gg/7dN4Ugu7aZ]Discord[/url] if you want to provide feedback or report bugs. You can subscribe to our channel at [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkNptxlV-XZ-lHnVjsJ9gWg]YouTube[/url] if you want to watch developer videos and you can watch Developer Log 1 [url=https://youtu.be/vXIgLrUkQiQ]here[/url]. 

In other news, we fixed a bug with the Videotape Player where it continues to play after the Power Plug has been removed.



Cheers,

[b]Astravelari Team[/b]

notes.title: Peek and you shall find... a new ending?
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings paranormal investigators![/h3]

It's been a while but we're back with a significant update! Halloween may be over IRL but 'tis always Halloween in the dormitory with the magpies! ːsteamhappyː



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/b0fb34e5722d0677a2520dacc8dd9f239e0efa65.png[/img]
[b]Ending B[/b] has been added!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/d4d9624c8d29235aa58522d41b91eb94856e94f1.png[/img]
The old [b]PEEK[/b] has been changed to [b]LOOK[/b] and the new [b]PEEK[/b] looks through the keyhole.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/6a7a7590c1108cb555f0a1f9a76ba955ebf15632.png[/img]
An [b]Anonymous Letter[/b] can be found along with the [b]Candle[/b] and the [b]Matchbox[/b].



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/d7395d32c6299f1dfc23ed645a545394f305295c.png[/img]
[b]Manual Elevators[/b] have been implemented.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/a5f24454e86cca0f3dabd9032962df271b604eef.png[/img]
[b]Sliding Gates[/b] have been implemented.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/1c355eea182a91e4e7eab1dbe86f33df34abc91f.png[/img]
[b]Upper Quarters Keys[/b] and [b]Lower Quarters Keys[/b] have been added.



Other changes and improvements are also listed below.

• The [b]Videotape Player[/b] automatically rewinds after it finishes playing and can be replayed by stopping it and then playing it again.
• The old [b]EXAMINE[/b] that automatically opens the inventory has now been changed to simply display the girl's thoughts as subtitles.
• New scary bits have been added. ːsteammockingː
• The maid's hair now has physics.
• The maids look more distinct from one another.
• Ambient lighting is slightly brighter.
• Some enemies no longer spawn in some areas on [b]EASY[/b] and [b]NORMAL[/b].
• Doors that lead to areas that are under construction can no longer be interacted with.
• Improved the overall quality of in-game music and sound effects.
• The starting [b]HP[/b] has been changed to 100% for easy, 75% for normal and 50% for hard.
• The [b]Cookies[/b] have been split so one is in one room and two are in another room.
• Fixed a bug where you can get stuck between the storage room door and a cart.
• Fixed a bug where marble floors did not produce footstep sounds.
• Fixed a bug where releasing a cart can sometimes prevent walking and running animations.
• Fixed an animation glitch that occurs at high frame rates.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/4b22a1dcd463a7f4d7d0af9df1a2418f1e151c72.png[/img]
Thank you very much [b]Tori Laing[/b] for getting the [b]Ghastly Tier[/b]! We are currently crowdfunding at [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/phantom-project/x/27241655#/]Indiegogo[/url] to develop the full game. If you enjoyed the prototype and wish to see more of [b]Phantom Project[/b], please support us at [url=www.astravelari.com]www.astravelari.com[/url]. We will also be uploading [b]Developer Videos[/b] on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkNptxlV-XZ-lHnVjsJ9gWg]YouTube[/url] so please subscribe to our channel.

Please follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Astravelari-101485318973297]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/AstravelariLLC]Twitter[/url] for more exciting news and join us on [url=https://discord.gg/7dN4Ugu7aZ]Discord[/url] if you want to provide feedback or report bugs.

We are now at [b]15,234[/b] players so thank you very much to all of you and always remember that it's all part of the test.



Cheers,

[b]Astravelari Team[/b]

notes.title: October 25, 2021 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings paranormal investigators![/h3]

Like always, we've been watching your videos and reading your feedback to see how we can further improve the game. More changes are pending and will be implemented in the near future but the current changes are listed below.

• Updated the enemy AI in the upper and lower quarters making it possible for players who have not yet solved the riddle to still have a chance to survive as long as they tread carefully.

• Updated the layout of the dormitory due to fan feedback regarding the trip from the top floor to the bottom floor being too tedious. A second elevator was installed and will be functional in the future.

• Thank you and congratulations [b]beinbeinbein ベイン[/b] for getting the [b]Supernatural Tier[/b]! You may read your letter from [b]Cynthia Lawson[/b] in the mailbox! Thank you [b]Juan Cordente[/b] for getting the [b]Ghastly Tier[/b]!

• Fixed an issue where the player gets stuck between a wall and a spawning enemy.

• Fixed an issue where the moonlight does not cast a shadow from a distance when the shadow quality is lower than ultra.

• Fixed an issue where the image for the brightness setting gets noisy when the anti-aliasing quality is lower than high.

Thank you very much for playing the game and for providing important feedback. As of now, we have more than 2700 players all over the world and it has only been 12 days. Please support us at [url=www.astravelari.com]www.astravelari.com[/url] as we continue to develop and campaign for the full game.



Cheers,

[b]Astravelari Team[/b]

notes.title: October 20, 2021 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings paranormal investigators![/h3]

We've seen a lot of your videos and we've listened to your feedback so we decided to update a few things.

• When the opening cutscene's script was being written, it actually had three objectives but only two were accomplished in the previous versions. The three objectives were to create an emotional connection between the player and the little girl, to show that there is a threat while still employing the fear of the unknown, and to show that the little girl is trying to accomplish something without revealing too much. We've finally figured out a scene that works with the final objective and so the opening cutscene was slightly modified.

• When it comes to giving players an objective, we'd rather show than tell so we don't just flash text that shows the objective somewhere on the screen. Instead, we'd like players to figure out the objective based on observation. Having said that, we've made changes to make the objective a lot easier to figure out.

• The inventory now remembers where you last looked. For example, if you look at a file and close the inventory, if you open it up again you will see the file that you last saw instead of the item tab.

Thank you very much for your feedback and stay tuned as we continue to update the game.



Cheers,

[b]Astravelari Team[/b]

tags.feature: • The inventory now remembers where you last looked.

notes.title: October 16, 2021 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings paranormal investigators![/h3]

For this small update, we've added room and floor sign plates to provide a better sense of direction since we've noticed that players keep trying to open the same locked doors. With the sign plates, traversed areas will be easier to remember.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/341260d180d7184e4ebe99891f89ed68d005fe28.jpg[/img]

The [b]COOKIE[/b] amount is now shown in the item itself. If the amount is three, you will now see three pieces of cookies instead of one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/ca73c1b97037e2c96a1a5350f2095fad6ae0135f.jpg[/img]

Lastly, the lighting and door states have been slightly adjusted and the spawn rates of the maids have been slightly adjusted.

Please feel free to provide us more feedback to improve the game. Thank you very much and always remember that it's all part of the test.



Cheers,

[b]Astravelari Team[/b]

notes.title: October 14, 2021 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings paranormal investigators![/h3]

We've been watching your playthroughs and we've released a small update to slightly tweak the difficulty and to clarify a few things that do not set the right expectations. The changes are listed below.

• The game previously starts at 70% HP but we've changed it to start at 100% HP.

• The [b]COOKIE[/b] item that recovers health now has three pieces instead of one.

• The [b]LOAD GAME[/b], [b]CONTINUE[/b], [b]COSTUMES[/b] and [b]GALLERY[/b] menu options have been removed since they are not yet implemented.

• The game has one ending in its current prototype state. The multiple endings previously listed in the [b]RECORDS[/b] menu have been removed and only the scores for the three difficulties, [b]EASY[/b], [b]NORMAL[/b] and [b]HARD[/b], will be shown.

• Fixed a few pathfinding issues for the Maid's AI.

Please feel free to provide us more feedback to improve the game. Thank you very much and always remember that it's all part of the test.



Cheers,

[b]Astravelari Team[/b]
